summary: Independent review of p02/ch12 chunk 1 (units 1-34). Counts: 4 errors, 68 minor (most minor items are machine patches: missing joined-token flags, 'such as' for ādi, Hindi glosses/brackets, grams). Errors: u16 both text_flags (chedaśabdaiṣṭo, pravarttanaśabdaiti) are regular hiatus (Devanagari has no ै), removed; u14 'rāja'+'jāhaka' does not match the printed 'rājāhaka' so the stretch is now unsplit/unclear and the hedgehog identification moved to notes; u19 the substituted grahāḥ/ketu-śani reading lacked the 'on a conjectural reading' mark; u12 the grouping of 'na' in 'śikhi...śveti na gajājaka payaśca' is fixed by punctuation in both languages and needs a human decision (no patch). No identification judged wrong; hedges added where tagged probable but unhedged (u13 cāṣa/bhāsa, u16 udara), apasmāra raised to standard (u32). Checker's 8 warnings are all regular sandhi (śubhāśubhaṃ, yo/yaḥ, śubhāśubhā), confirmed. Notes quoted the print wrongly in u4 ('loṣṭopāṃgāra'; print is loṣṭupāṃgāra) - corrected. Hindi brackets '(अनुमानित पाठ पर)' in u8,u10,u14,u19 replaced by inline commas. Human decisions: u4 long list (literal 'or', aneka, conjectures), u10 (item count vs 108, honey(-like), cloud 'heavy'), u12 na, u16 udara disease vs belly, u19 scope of na and śubhāśubhā attachment, u21 list after tathā (kept without predicate). Regrouping: no change needed in units; optional note that u21-u23 form one sentence (u22 and u23 are fragments continuing u21) and u24-u34 are one verbless series.
glossary_suggestions: (from p02 ch12 k1 review) IAST ai/au hiatus again: chedaśabdaiṣṭo (छेदशब्दइष्टो) and pravarttanaśabdaiti (प्रवर्त्तनशब्दइति) print the vowels separately - regular hiatus after -aḥ, never a typo flag.
Hindi never uses brackets: the mark is inline ', अनुमानित पाठ पर,' next to the substituted word (not '(अनुमानित पाठ पर)'), and no closing meta-sentence about conjectural members.
Every substituted word adopted in `words` needs the mark in both translations (u19 grahāḥ, ketu-śani were missing); letter-level deletions (lābhartu-) remain the OPEN criterion.

A gloss never carries a guess for a damaged word (spṛk: 'unclear (as printed)', guess in flag/note only). A stretch whose split does not reproduce the printed letters (godharājāhaka as rāja+jāhaka) stays unsplit 'unclear'.

Tokens split in `words` with no printed space and no sandhi (including ṃ before a consonant and visarga before s) each need a flag; list for this chunk: vilikhan|gṛhītvā, deśe|kāle, rudan|niṣṭhuraḥ, vaidyaṃ|suptaṃ, viklavaṃ|chindantam, sahasraṃ|narāṇāṃ, maṅgalānāṃ|śataṃ, darśanāt|sparśanāt|kīrtanāt, bhūmir|abhyuddhṛtā|siddham, apatya|kṣamā, api|ca, mahat|sadyaḥ, ca|punar, jāyate|saḥ, yasya|nagnasya, tasya|netra-.
Bare dvandva stems (before iti, or inside a larger compound) carry gram 'dvandva (stem)', not 'm. nom. sg.'.

chardi = छर्दि यानी उलटी (not वमन); atisāra = अतिसार यानी दस्त; granthi = ग्रन्थि यानी गाँठ; arbuda = अर्बुद यानी रसौली; gulma = गुल्म यानी पेट की गाँठ; raktapitta = रक्तपित्त यानी रक्तस्राव का रोग; udāvarta = उदावर्त यानी वायु का ऊपर की ओर पलटना; chuchundarī = छछूंदर; vāmana = वामन यानी बौना; apasmāra = epilepsy (standard) / अपस्मार यानी मिर्गी.
hanyate = 'is struck down' / आहत होता है (not 'मारा जाता है'); apica = 'And further.' / और भी।; śvapāka = dog-cooker, outcaste.
